notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: this week s Steam new release highlights
notes.content:
Welcome back to Unknown Pleasures, our weekly round-up of the best new but under-reported games released on Steam over the past seven days.

This week: SF startup simulation, nihilistic Tetris, toilet humour and fantasy RPG Tinder.

notes.title: Gotta Go Steam Trading Cards Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29746043/65847705990c4e996fff49f9a24df5e9ed1fa735.png[/img]

The Gotta Go trading cards, badges, emojis and backgrounds are now live!

We wanted to have these out in time for launch but sometimes a few extra days of work and review pays off! We invite you to collect, trade, and complete your trading card sets so you can claim some sweet backgrounds, badges and emoticons.  There are some good ones in there.

Especially the foil card set and the emoticon that comes with it. It is truly a prize.

So get out there! Save you pants, have fun and when you are done there will be a few trading cards waiting for you in your inventory.

The Dire Nerd Team-
